text.body: bhāvadīpaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ natvā pūrṇabodhādisadgurūn | gītātātparyaṭīkāyā bhāvadīpaṃ karomyaham || sakalavāṅmanasadevatendriropasarjanakabhagavannatirūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ granthādāvācarati || indireti || etacca na sokhyātiśayāya, kintu tadanugrahārthameveti bhāvenoktamamandetyādi | 'aśarīraḥ prajñātmā' ityukteḥ kathamaśarīrasya vadanāmbhojarājahaṃsatvamiti śaṅ‌kāsatvamiti śaṃkānirāsāyoktaṃ sundarākṛtaya iti | prākṛtadehaniṣedhaparā śrutiriti bhāvaḥ | granthakartṛnnamati || dharmeti || gurutvādbahuvacanam | evamagre'pi | prācīnaṭīkākartṛnarthayate || sa padmanābheti || sūryakiraṇasamūho yathā lokasya jñānāya bhavati, tathaiteṣāṃ vāksamūho mama jñānāyāstu | uttarārdhe'pyarthadvayaṃ jñeyam | śrīpadmanābheti pāṭhe yacchabdaśravaṇāt sa gogaṇa iti yojyam | akṣobhyatīrthākhyakhagurūn natvā cikīrṣitaṃ pratijānīte || praṇamyeti || || atheti || pratigranthavyākhyā''rabhyata ityārambhārtho'thaśabdaḥ | vyākhyāne bīcoktiraśeṣetyādi | yathāvadityetadghaṭanāyoktamanyairityādi | parisamāptyādītyādipadena pracayasaṅgrahaḥ | paramparādītyādipadena tadanumitāyāḥ 'prāripsitasamāptyādikāmaḥ sveṣṭadevatānatiṃ kuryāt' iti śrutergrahaḥ | nibandhanasya kṛtyoktiḥ śiṣyeti | śiṣyairapyetadavaśyaṃ kāryamiti jñāpanārthamityarthaḥ | samastapadenāpaunaruktyamāha || sampūrṇamiti || sammatagītāsviti || veṇugītābhramaragītāgopikāgītābhikṣugītetyādirūpāsvatyarthaḥ | || tasyā eveti || bhāratasya vā tadantargatagranthāntarasya vā tyāgeneti yojyam | nanvityādinā kṛtacodyasya śāstreṣviti ślokasthapūrvottarārdhatātparyoktyottaramāha bhāratasyetyādinā | pratinidheḥ pāṣāṇādeḥ | mahattvaṃ bhāraheturityāha || mahatvāttata eva bhāreṇa tatatvāditi || mahatvādbhāro mahabhāraḥ | niruktatvādeva mahata ā pañcamīsamāsaśca jñeyaḥ | tena mahābhāreṇa tatatvādvyāptatvāt | mahābhāropapadāt tanoterḍapratyaya iti bhāvaḥ | nirvacanamavayavārthakathanam | 'eṣa viṣṇorbhagavataḥ kalā bhuvanapāvanī' ityādi pṛthuṃ prati traṣibhiruktaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā śaṃkate || pṛthyavādiṣviti || ādipadena balarāmakārtavīryārjunādigrahaḥ | 'āviveśa pṛthuṃ devaḥ śaṅkhī cakrī caturbhūjaḥ' ita, 'pṛthuhaihayādayo jīvāsteṣvāviṣṭo hariḥ svayam' ityādivacanātteṣāṃ na sākṣādavatāratvamastīti bhāvena svayaṃśabdārthamāha || sākṣānnārāyaṇeti || guhyeti || bhāṣādvayaṃ bhāratatātparyadvitīye vyaktam | anyatra purāṇeṣu || upoddhātaḥ || anukūlayiṣyanniti || saṅkṣepeṇokte prapañcaṃ jijñāsavo bhavantīti prapañcane'pi jijñānājananamatrānumūlanamiti bhāvaḥ || iti śeṣa iti || nārāyaṇapadānantaraṃ itipadaṃ kathyata iti padañcādhyāhāryamityarthaḥ || iti smateriti || 'jñānenāsau vibharti mām' iti bhāgavatasmṛterityarthaḥ || atra jñānitve || 'naiva devapadaṃ prāptā brahmadarśanavarjitāḥ' | iti smṛteriti bhāvaḥ || atraiveti || dviṭ‌tadanubandhinigraha evetyarthaḥ || keṣāñciditi || duryodhanādīnāṃ | bhīṣmadroṇādīnāṃ tadanubandhitvāditi bhāvaḥ || śāstraviduṣā || arjunenetyarthaḥ || dharmaikadeśa iti || yuddharūpe | samagradharmaḥ svavihitavṛttibhagavadbhaktyādirūpaḥ || militameveti || bhaktivairāgyādipūrvakaṃ svavihitavṛttiḥ paramadharma ityarthaḥ | yuddhanivṛttirapi paramadharmaviruddhatvādadharma eveti tadbodhanamapi kāryamevetyarthaḥ || tathābhāvāt || dharmādharmabhāvādityarthaḥ | tadviruddhamapi dharmatvena niyamayati cet dharmo bhavatyevetyata āha || tasya ceti || hareḥ svabhaktyādipūrvakasvavihitavṛttitadviruddharūpayoreva dharmādharmatvena niyamanopapattirityarthaḥ || uktavidhasyeti || bhaktipūrvaṃ svavihitavṛttyā kriyamāṇasya bhagavadārādhanasyetyarthaḥ | kartavyatve hetuścaturthapādena labdha iti bhāvenāha || mokṣeti || te hitamiti māmevaiṣyasītyābhyāṃ labdhahet āha hitetyādinā || tyājyatvaṃ ceti || avagamyata iti yojyam | tadvyanakti bhaktyetyādinā | svadharmeṇetyanuvādena śeṣamāha || bhaktyā ceti saṃyojyamiti || bhaktyā bhagavadārādhanameva dharmastadviruddhastvadharma ityeṣortho'nena kathaṃ labdha ityata āha || kartavyeti || paramadharmatvena bhaktirgītāyāmabhimateti kuta ityato mūlaṃ yojayati || parokṣeti || jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ cetyuktaparokṣāparokṣayoḥ praveṣṭuṃ cetyuktajñānimokṣasya ca bhaktyā tvananyayeti bhaktyadhīnatvāvagamādityarthaḥ || anyatheti || jñānasya śravaṇādyadhīnatva ityarthaḥ | śaṃkottaratvena mūlārthamāha || śravaṇāderiti || uttamatvasyeti || tathā ca sūtraṃ pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāttvanubandhaḥ iti || tatreti || sarvadharmāniti śloke kartavyasya tyājyasya cābhāvo'bhimata ityarthaḥ | heyopādeyābhāvena śaraṇāgatireva tasyābhiprāya iti śaṃkiturbhāvaḥ | yadvā tatretyasya gītāyāmityartha iti jñeyam | etad‌dvayaṃ matkarmakṛnmatparama iti śloke kathamabagamyata ityato'nuvādavyājena vyanakti yaduktamityādinā | gītāpadārthamuktvā tatkarmeti mūlapadasyārthamāha || tadeva tatkarmeti || karmadhāraya ityuktaṃ bhavati | asmacchabdāttadbhagavadviṣayaṃ karmaiva bhaktasya karmetyarthaḥ | tadarthatvena bhagavadarthatvena niṣiddhamevetyarthaḥ || tatreti || gītāyāmityarthaḥ | tadvyañjayan mūlārthamāha || svavihitamiti || avagamyata iti sarvatra yojyamiti prāgevoktam | tadubhayamityasya svavihitaṃ bhagavadarthaṃ cetyarthaḥ || ityaneneti || ityardhenetyarthaḥ | sākṣātparamparayeti || nirdoṣatvenetyantasya sākṣādapekṣitatvam | anyeṣāṃ tu paramparayā || abhinne nissvarūpe svasmāduttame vastuni svasya sārvajñasarvaśaktyādiguṇahīnatvena, jananamṛtyādidoṣavattve sārvakālike sārvadaiśike ca sarvavastuni niyamanāyogāt, anyādhīnatve tadanumatiṃ vinā svecchā'didvārā'nyasyaiva mokṣahetutve pumarthadānadvārā śāstrapratipādyatvasyāpi vidhiniṣedhajñāpanasyopāstyādidvārā niyamanasyākāryatvāditi bhāvaḥ || sarvasya tadadhīnatvamiti || 'lokamaheśvaram' ityaneneti bhāvaḥ || buddhiritīti || sarvasya tadadhīnatvamiti || 'bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ' iti vākyaśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ | saptarṣaya ityupakramya 'etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ | sovikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | iti vākyaśeṣeśravaṇādāha || niṣkampeti || karaṇavyutpattimupetyāha || sarvaśāstrāṇāmiti || jñānavijñānapadayoḥ śāstrarthatve'pi bhagavatparatvaṃ kathaṃ labdhamityata uktam || bhagavaditi || 'yajjñātvā' ityardhenokterityarthaḥ | yadvā 'yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati' ityādau bhagavajjñānenaiva sarvasya jñātatvokteriha ca 'yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyat' ityādinā jñātatvokterbhagavatparatvaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ siddhamityarthaḥ | prādhānyoktiriti || rājavidyetyasya pradhānavidyeti vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ || tajjñānānmokṣaśceti || sukhasyaikāntikasya pratiṣṭhā'hamityukteriti bhāvaḥ | anya ityukterāha || bheda iti || uttama ityukteruktāmuttamatvamiti | bibhartītyukterāha || sarvasya tadadhīnatvamiti || 'loke vede ca prathitaḥ' ityukterāha || sarvaśāstrāṇāmiti || buddhimān kṛtakṛtyaścetyukterāha || tajjñānānmokṣaśceti || asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ ta iti || tenāsatyatā'divādināṃ nindayā jagatsatyatvāvagamāditi bhāvaḥ || yaduktamiti || kuru karmetyādivākmudāhṛtya jñāninopi bhagavatkarmeti yaduktamityarthaḥ | jñānināpi rādhyaḥ sādhyaḥ || mokṣāniyamāditi || 'aniyamaḥ sarveṣām' iti sūtrāditi bhāvaḥ | yacchabdaśravaṇādāha || teneti śeṣa iti || varṇāśramocitakarmaṇetyarthaḥ || tasmāditi veti || karma kuryādityanena tasmādityasyānvaya iti bhāvaḥ | sādhanottamatvamityādītyādipadena parokṣāparokṣarjñānino'pi mokṣasya tadadhīnatvaṃ ceti gṛhyate || ucyata iti || 'bhaktyā prasannaḥ paramo dadyād‌jñānaṃ' ityanenocyata ityarthaḥ || śravaṇāderiti || 'ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ' ityādāviti bhāvaḥ || mokṣādiriti || jñānamādipadārthaḥ | 'dṛṣṭyādistasya sādhanam' ityatrādipadena dhyānaṃ śravaṇamanena ca grāhye | tasyetyanena ca bhaktiśabdārthatayokto yaḥ snehaḥ sa cātiparipakvaḥ paripakvaḥ aparipakva iti trividho'pi gṛhyata ityupetya dṛṣṭhyādimadhye kiṃ kasya bhaktirūpasya snehasya sādhanamityatastadvivekena darśayan kathaṃ bhakterityādisoktaśaṃkā nirāha || atiparipakva ityādinā || yoga upāyaḥ || tatsādhanatvāditi || mokṣasādhanātiparipakvabhaktisādhanatvādityarthaḥ | tatsādhanamiti || dṛṣṭisādhanaparipakvabhaktisādhanamityarthaḥ | śravaṇādītyādipadena mananagrahaḥ | yaduktamiti || 'sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ' ityādyudāhṛktamityarthaḥ | devatvāduttamādhikāritvamityanuvādaḥ svakṛtavyākhyānānurodheneti jñeyam | vyāptau ceti || ye devāste'dhikāryuttamā iti mūle vyāptirabhimateti bhāvaḥ || yadviṣṇoriti || 'na tvatsamo'sti' ityādyudāhṛtyoktamityarthaḥ | mī lahuṣo'milaṣitasecakasya | eṣasya ā samantādīśasya | vayāḥ bandhakaḥ | prabharaṇe pūjāyām | rudriye, rudraśabdāddhaḥ, raudram | vide vivide, vid‌lṛ lābhe, lebha ityarthaḥ | yathā tatheti śeṣoktiḥ || yāsiṣṭamiti śravaṇādyuvāmityarthaḥ | irāvat annavat | vartiḥ vartanam | vṛterikārapratyayo bhāvārtha iti bhāvaḥ | yāsiṣṭam ayāsiṣṭam | aḍabhāvaśchāndasaḥ | prāptau stha ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ samacintayadityataḥ svayamāha ete vakṣyamāṇā jāyantāmitīti | śrautapadārthamāha || satyaṃ mukhyamiti, tato viṣṇuta iti ca || mātrayā mātrāyāḥ miteḥ | tanvā vṛdhāna mūrtyaiva pūrṇo'si | anye iti śeṣoktiḥ | anvaśnuvanti, aśū vyāptau, prāpnuvanti || yaduktamiti || 'paśyannapīmamātmānam' ityādinoktamityarthaḥ || pūrvottareti || ' sthitaprajñasya kā bhāṣā samādhisthasya ' iti śloke'tra vivakṣitasya muktasya prakṛtatvāt | ' naiva tasya kṛtenārthaḥ ' ityuttaravākye muktaliṅgaśravaṇāttadanusāreṇa cetyarthaḥ | bhāṣyānusārādatra muktaśabdaḥ samādhisthapara ityāha || atra sarvatheti || ' samādhisthopi ' ityapipadādarthadvayaparaḥ śloka ityeke | ' jñānayogena sāṅkhyānām ' ityasya tātparyamāha || jñānenaiveti || sāṅkhyānāmityasyārtho jñānināmiti | śaṃkate || nātreti || yaduktamiti || ' sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpam ' ityādinā'rjuno jñānīti yaduktamityarthaḥ || iti saṃkṣepeṇa gītātātparyoktiḥ || saṅgrahoktyaiveti || ' tatra sākṣādindrāvatāram ' ityādineti bhāvaḥ || dṛṣṭ‌vemamityādineti || pūrvādhyāye ' dṛṣṭvemaṃ svajanaṃ kṛṣṇa ' ityādinā bhayakampagāṇḍīvastraṃsanāderyuddhanivṛttāvupapatteruktatvādityarthaḥ || uttarārdhamupādatta iti || arthastu spaṣṭaḥ | caśabda upamā'rtho dhyeya iti bhāvaḥ || satyamiti || bandhusnehanimittānnāśabhayāt ' na yotsye ' ityetatsatyamityarjunoktiparihāhārthaṃ vikalpayatītyanvayaḥ || taditi || uktarūpamarjunavacanamityarthaḥ | evamevetyasya paramacetanatveneti bhramanirāsāyāha || cetanamātratveneti || atiśayena nityatvameveti || ' cetanaścetanānām ' ityatreti bhāvaḥ || vivakṣiteti || svarūpato dehataśca prāgabhāvavināśayorabhāvarūpo'rthaḥ || ubhayavidheti || svarūpato dehataścetyarthaḥ | pratīkagrahaṇabalācchaṃkānirāsalābha iti bhāvenāha || tuśabdeneti || lokapadena vivakṣitamarthamāha || praptaityādinā || aneneti || lekasya prasaktikathanenārjunāpekṣayā'prastutatvoktivirodho netyarthaḥ || saraṇaṃ gamanamiti || sū gatāviti dhātoḥ | ye gatyarthāste jñānārthā iti bhāvaḥ | ' nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ ' ityetāvatā prakṛtaśaṃkā'parihārādāha || dṛṣṭānta iti || uttarārdheti || ' ubhayorapi dṛṣṭo'ntastvanayostattvadarśibhiḥ ' ityattarārdhe sadasatkarmabhyāṃ sukhadukhe na sta ityanayorarthayoranto nirṇayastattvadarśabhirdṛṣṭa ityuktyā naiyatyaṃ labdhamiti bhāvaḥ | prakṛtopayogamāha || aśraddhayeti || ' aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat || asadityucyate pārtha ' ityaṣṭādaśe ' sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ' ityetasmātkiñciduparitanaṃ vākyaṃ ca grāhyamityarthaḥ || vetteti || vida jñāne, veditetyarthaḥ | āgamaśāsanamanityamitīḍatra na kṛtaḥ | nanu vidyamānāvidyamānayoriti vaktavyam | vidyamānaśabdasya ' alpāc‌taraṃ pūrvam ' iti sūtreṇa, tathā bhāvasyābhāvāpekṣayā'bhyarhitatvena ' abhyarhitaṃ pūrvam ' iti sūtreṇa pūrvanipātena bhāvyatvādityata āha || gītānusāreṇoti || utpattināśeti || avidyamānasyotpattivyavahāreṇa vidyamānasya nāśavyavahāreṇetyarthaḥ || kimidamiti || kaṇṭhavyavahāramūlabhūtaṃ kimanumānāgamārthāpattijaṃ jñānamuta bhrama ityarthaḥ | ghaṭitamiti || sadasatkarma paratvenānyathā yojitamityarthaḥ || tāviti || vittivyavahāhāvityarthaḥ | atosannava jāyata ityanantaraṃ śeṣamāha || sanvinaśyatīti copasaṃhāro draṣṭavya iti || kimiti || uktyā kimityarthaḥ || rūpabhedeneti || kāryarūpeṇasataḥ kāraṇarūpeṇa sato janmetyarthaḥ || kuta etaditi || asato janma sato vināśa ityetadityarthaḥ || bhramaviṣayasyeti || śuktirūpyādeḥ khyātibādhānyathānupapattirūpārthāpattyetyarthaḥ || prācīnapakṣa iti || asato'sattvena pratītirneti pakṣe mānābhāvarūpadūṣaṇāntaramityarthaḥ || caśabdārthamāha || na kevalamiti || taddharmeti || pratītatvarūpadharmetyarthaḥ || tadbhāvo'pīti || asatassattvena pratītibhāvo'pītyarthaḥ || bādhakajñānasyāpīti || śrutau ptatītaṃ rūpamanirvacanīyameva na vyāvahārikaṃ sadapīti parasya bādhakajñānodayāditi bhāvaḥ || anirvacanīyatvavirodhāditi || satyabhūtasattvāśrayatya sadvailakṣaṇyāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | maghavānāvityasyārtho yaśasvināviti | ' yaśo vā va magham ' iti karmanirṇaye yaśo'rthakatve maghaśabdasya śrutyukteḥ | acchendrābrahmaṇaspatī ' ityatra brahmaṇaspatiśabdartho bṛhaspatirityupetyāha || indrabṛhaspatī iti || indrābṛhaspatīti bhāvyam | ' devatādvandve ca ' iti pūrvapadasyā naṅukteḥ | ' yuvoridāpaścana praminanti vrataṃ vām ' iti śeṣasyārthamāha || yuvayorityādinā || yuvoḥ yuvayoḥ | idityasyārtha eveti | vratamityasyārthasatyetyādi | āpaścaneti padadvayārthaṛ sarvadevatā apīti || praminanti jānanti | ' tanna moghaṃ vasu spārhamuta jetota dātā ' iti śeṣatyārthoktipūrvamupāttapadānāmarthamāha || sarvajña iti || tatkartavyamiti || tadyuddhakarma kartavyam | pūjātvena kāryamityanupadameva ' tasmādyadhyasva ' ityatra vakṣyatīti vakṣyatikriyayoktvetyasyānvayaḥ || ubhayoḥ yīveśvarayoḥ || atra jīvasyeti || atra avisāśi tviti śloke jīvasya pratipādyatāyāśca niṣedhyatāparaṃ bhāṣyamamukhyārthaparam | jīvaparatve'mukhyatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || tatreti | harāvityarthaḥ | tarhi mukhyārthaviṣṇupara evāyaṃ śloko'stvityata āha || na tvevāhamiti || ādipadaprakṣepeṇeti || dehahānyādītyādipadetyarthaḥ || kathañciditi || svābhāvikānāśanaimittikanāśabhedenārthabhedakalpanamityarthaḥ || atrocyata iti || tātparyanirṇayākhyaitadvantha ityarthaḥ || bhāṣye tviti || na ca naimittikanāśa ityāhetyādinā jīvarūpārthāntaramucyata ityarthaḥ || bhagavateti || bhāṣyakṛtetyarthaḥ || jaḍābhāvamuktveti || na vartata ityādineti bhāvaḥ || śarīreti | ' śyāmāvadāttāḥ ' ityādineti jñeyam || etadvākyayoriti || ' yo veda ' iti, ' ānandamayam ' iti vākyayoḥ ' brahmāvidāpnoti param ' ityuktaparabrahmaprakaraṇagatatvādityarthaḥ | yaśorūpeṇeti || yaśonāmakarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | ' tasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ ' iti śruteḥ | īśvareṇeti || sakhyeti yojyam | ' kilbiṣaspṛtpitupaṇirhyeṣāmaraṃhito bhavati vājināya ' iti śeṣārthamāha || yato'sāviti || ' gāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu | brahmā tvo vadati cātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vimita u tvaḥ ' iti śeṣārthamāha || kaścidityādinā || jakṣabhakṣahasanayoriti dhātoḥ jakṣannityasyārthadvayamāha || bhakṣayan hasaṃśceti || ' manojaveṣu ' ityasyārtho jñānādiguṇeṣviti || ' ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tvehradā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre ' iti śeṣārthamāha || tatra keciditi || śrutvā viṣṇumiti || ' śrutvā viṣṇuṃ karṇaphalaṃ prāptatvātkarṇasaṃyutāḥ | akṣaṇvanto darśanācca viṣṇormuktāstu ye gaṇāḥ || tāratamyaṃ ca teṣāṃ ca śrutāvuditamañjasā |
